Epicor returns a broad superset matching the prefix text before any %, _, [, ] or non-ASCII character; Herbert applies the literal prefixes locally and validates identities and Content type/UTF-16 length only for selected definitions. Excluded definitions are neither validated nor reported. Selected personal owners keep complete Content, native XML, scripts and all composite variants. Empty selected pages follow raw native continuation. Exact seven-key retrieval ignores both prefixes.
